dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Schneider (for himself and Ms. Kelly of Illinois) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to enhance prescription drug affordability by expanding access to assistance with out-of-pocket costs under Medicare part D for low-income seniors and individuals with disabilities.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Medicare Extra Rx Higher Eligibility Limits in Part D Act of 2019 or the Medicare Extra Rx HELP Act of 2019.

section.header: Enhancing prescription drug affordability by expanding access to assistance with out-of-pocket costs under Medicare part D for low-income seniors and individuals with disabilities

subsection.text: Section 1860D–14 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w–114) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in the heading, by striking 150 percent and inserting 200 percent;

clause.text: in the heading, by striking 135 percent and inserting 200 percent; and

subclause.text: by striking 135 percent and inserting 200 percent; and

by striking and who meets the resources requirement described in paragraph (3)(D) or who is covered under this paragraph under paragraph (3)(B)(i) and inserting or who is covered under this paragraph under paragraph (3)(B)(v);
in clause (i), by adding and at the end;

item.text: by striking 150 percent and inserting 200 percent; and
by striking ; and at the end and inserting a period; and

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (4), by striking subparagraph (B); and

paragraph.text: in subsection (c)(1), in the second sentence, by striking subsections (a)(1)(D) and (a)(2)(E) and inserting subsection (a)(1)(D).

subsection.text: Section 1905(p)(1) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1396d(p)(1)) is amended by adding at the end the following flush matter:

quoted-block.quoted-block-continuation-text: The Secretary shall apply subparagraph (C) as if the amendments made by section 2(a) of the Medicare Extra Rx Higher Eligibility Limits in Part D Act of 2019 had not been enacted and shall continue to calculate the maximum resource level applied for a year under section 1860D–14(a)(3)(D) (as in effect on the day before the date of enactment of such Act) without regard to such amendments.

subsection.text: The amendments made by subsection (a) shall apply to plan year 2020 and subsequent plan years.
